# realuptime Provider

Manage RealUptime monitors (checks), status pages, status page components and notification channels through the REST API v1. The REST API is available on the Growth and Scale plans; generate an API key with **read_write** permission from the dashboard's API & MCP access section (a read-only key can only read).

Source: the `packages/terraform-provider-realuptime` directory of the RealUptime monorepo, mirrored to [github.com/RealUptimeHQ/terraform-provider-realuptime](https://github.com/RealUptimeHQ/terraform-provider-realuptime). Every attribute is hand-mapped from the OpenAPI 3.1 document at `https://realuptime.io/api/v1/openapi.json`; field names are the API's own. REST API reference: https://docs.realuptime.io/api.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    realuptime = {
      source  = "RealUptimeHQ/realuptime"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

# The key comes from REALUPTIME_API_KEY; set api_key here only from a secret
# store, never a literal. base_url is optional (REALUPTIME_API_URL also works).
provider "realuptime" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by internal/docsgen -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String) API key, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>` on every request. Falls back to the `REALUPTIME_API_KEY` environment variable. Keep it out of your configuration: prefer the environment variable or a secret store. (Sensitive.)
- `base_url` (String) API root. Defaults to `https://realuptime.io/api/v1`, or the `REALUPTIME_API_URL` environment variable when set (the same variable the RealUptime CLI reads). Override it only to point at a local development server.
